{{Quote|Okay Chewie&mdash;these space-happy clowns ''started'' this little clambake... let's ''end'' it for em ''fast''.|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]|<ref name="Star Wars (1977) 7">[[Star Wars (1977) 7|''Star Wars'' (1977) 7]]</ref>}}
'''Clams''' were mollusks with two shells that could close together to protect the creature's soft body. Numerous [[Species/Legends|species]] existed on several [[Planet/Legends|worlds]].

A "clambake" was also a [[List of phrases and slang/Legends|slang term]] for a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]]-fight.

The [[Sessehshellah]], the native [[Species/Legends|species]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Shaymore]], used sharpened clam shells attached to sticks as weapons.<ref name="Bright Water">{{WEGCite|story=Rings of Bright Water|book=Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)}}</ref>
